items.title: Hampstead Heath Photo Exhibition
items.summary: Join us at The Kenwood Dairy for an exhibition of this year’s top Hampstead Heath photo competition entries. The exhibition will include spectacular photographs of Hampstead Heath, including this year’s winning entry, a beautiful image by Joe Hayman, and the winning under 18s entry, a great shot by Milo Dawes, aged 13. No need to book, stop by between 10am-3pm from the 26th-28th of November. Teas and coffees to warm up also available for a donation, and there’ll be an opportunity to buy the Hampstead Heath Calendar as well as other Heath-related goodies. Milo Dawes - under 18s winner Joe Hayman - adult category winner

items.title: Nature Journaling Workshop
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk and nature journaling workshop on the Kenwood Estate . Nature journaling is a method of recording and collecting your observations in a variety of ways - note making, sketching, writing or whatever method works best for you. Nature journaling can enrich your experience of the natural world, deepen your relationship with the local environment and help develop your identification skills. The £10 donation covers materials and our session leader’s time, but do let us know if that is unaffordable. FREE for Heath Hands members and for children under 18. You can also bring your own notebooks or pens if you wish. Also, feel free to bring your phones to take photos to draw from and try out some helpful apps. We'll share how technology can be used to bolster a nature journaling practice. All welcome. You do not need to be an artist or a naturalist to enjoy this workshop! Anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. We will be meeting on the Kenwood Estate - we’ll share the exact meeting point once you’ve booked. Please note, this event will be held mostly outside. If the weather is bad we may have to reschedule, but we will still go ahead if there’s a bit of rain! Our workshop leader Shilpa Agashe has also produced a Nature Journaling Workbook to use on your own adventures, which can be purchased via our webshop here . Find out more about Shilpa’s work here , or visit her website: shilpaagashe.com Book here

items.title: Keats House: Festivity in Romantic Poetry
items.summary: Join Keats House for an evening of discussion on Romantic Festivity with UCL's Gregory Dart. In 1817 Leigh Hunt complained that Christmas had become a 'dreary business'. But why? What were the causes of the Romantics' Christmas crisis? And how did they attempt to address it in their poetry? In this talk Gregory Dart will run through Romantic meditations on festivity, holidays and holydays, feasts and fasts, from Scott and Burns through Leigh Hunt, Letitia Landon and Wordsworth, to Keats, taking in the influence of the French Revolution, the Victory Celebrations of 1814, Malthus's theories of population and the antiquarian revival. 6.30pm - doors open, soft drinks available and time to look round the house 7pm - talk, followed by questions This event and any associated ticketing and personal data capture is managed directly by the City of London Corporation. Learn more
